answer: Each funding cluster shares one daily quota of 50 rewarded actions, tracked on-chain from funding links within three hops, so a lone honest identity uses the full quota while a herd splits it. Registering an identity costs a 2 POA fee, and every extra fake pays another fee yet adds no new quota, so 100 fakes divide the same 50 actions and each earns a faint echo of an honest share. The quota resets at dawn, and a cluster that tries to game it finds its jade-green allowance spent. Verifiers replay the funding graph and quota ledger to confirm each action stayed inside its cluster cap.
